name: Focus mode
author: Daniel Killenberger
description: Plugin-owned distraction list with exclusive windows, always-on off-space site block, and a conscious-choice intercept banner. Focus mode asks purpose and minutes on start, auto-off on the timer, and one closing window after you leave.
